name: kenya-cinemas-monorepo
description: Cinema Management Platform Multi-Tenant SaaS Monorepo

scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.format:fix: cd backend && ruff format . && cd ../frontend && npm run format
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.audit: npm run audit:backend && npm run audit:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run test
